    orig = []

        yi = ys[i]
        base = i << 11
        for j in range(i + 1, n):

            dy = yi - ys[j]
            d = dx * dx + dy * dy
            append((d << 22) | base | j)

    orig.sort(reverse=True)

                if cand > new[j]:
